snippets.text: SemiAnalysis says an AMD MI355X running TileRT reached 470 tokens a second on GLM-5.3 in FP8, which it puts over 40% ahead of a GB300 using TensorRT-LLM in FP4.
ComfyUI published an animation workflow whose Multi-Angle Camera node turns direction, elevation and distance controls into a camera description, then passes it to GPT Image 2.
TestingCatalog says it found references to a $500-a-month ChatGPT Pro Max plan, and that OpenAI has not confirmed a link between the plan and Cerebras.
Theo says Claude Opus 5.5 filed a pull request that changes streaming behaviour in T3 Code, and recorded a video demo of the change inside the pull request.
Epson Robots added the AX6 to its six-axis line, a lightweight force- and power-limited arm with no-code programming, The Robot Report said.
Datasette shipped 1.0a41, with OpenTelemetry support contributed by Alex Garcia and every modal dialog moved into one documented Web Component, Simon Willison said.
Simon Willison released commit-rewriter 0.2, which can now run against a branch other than the default one using uvx commit-rewriter --branch.
AWS published a WhisperX Deep Learning Container that packages Whisper, wav2vec2 forced alignment and speaker diarisation into one GPU-ready image for SageMaker endpoints.
Nvidia posted a guide to training mixture-of-experts biological foundation models, arguing dense transformers cost too much because every token passes through every layer.
Wired's reviewer said the Instinct agent saved him $550 and booked restaurant reservations, but also wasted $64 and may be a security nightmare.
British Columbia is suing OpenAI and Sam Altman over the Tumbler Ridge school shooting, saying OpenAI reviewers wanted to call police first, Tom's Hardware reported.
Krea said its generation tools are coming to Meta's Muse assistant, without giving a date or saying which of them will be available.
